textPolicy: Original project-written motivational lists; no real-person attribution, no copied quotes, no AP/news text.
visualPolicy: Backgrounds intentionally contain no readable text, logos, watermarks, social handles, or channel plaques.
audioPolicy: Motivation audio beds are local ffmpeg synth files documented in assets/audio/motivation/README.md.
safetyRules: Avoid protected-class insults, gender hostility, political framing, sexual content, violence, medical claims and guaranteed success promises.
Keep advice general, motivational and non-clinical.
No channel watermark or subscription plaque; decorative cinematic texture is allowed.
